V2 changes and additional admission boundaries:
- STOP once at actual entry spawn_begin_monotonic+entry wall_seconds-90 during outstanding GEN.
  Full GEN send completion required first; STOP cannot interleave partial GEN bytes. Flag published
  before send; recursive send polling sees flag and never sends second STOP. Actual owned stdin
  only, 5s bounded send, no reset/new kill command. Before GEN require actual90s grace reserve.
  Cancellation DONE remains primary failure, complete=false/passed=false/performance ineligible;
  responsive DONE boundary gets normal QUIT/reap. No cancelled run becomes PASS even if DONE length16.
  If engine is unresponsive beyond finite owner deadline, inherited qualified owner's emergency pidfd
  failure closure remains unmodified, never PASS; this packet introduces no raw kill/reset or retry.
- clean actual_route=null. source_bound_route, inferred_from_source=true and route_evidence_scope
  explicitly separate source prediction from observed debug trace. Debug inferred_from_source=false.
- Pair completion independent of ON/OFF identity: debug OFF->ON, timed1 OFF->ON, timed2 ON->OFF,
  timed3 OFF->ON, heldout OFF->ON. Final summary requires five completed equal pairs. Metadata normalizes
  OFF/ON wall and engine samples regardless order; previous receipt is always named previous_record.
- Every held-out identity caller gates stat bytes<=2MiB BEFORE first hash/read, including admission,
  source_guard and body. Oversized input CPU fixture traps any attempted sha call.
- STRATA_MTP_PREFILL_SYNC=1 explicit stable base on every arm. Actual consumer src/core/mtp.cpp
  MtpDrafter::prefill lines1060/1081-1083 selects per_group_sync branch; checked per-group complete()
  before next CPU mapped-record write around1161. generate.cpp2495 setenv only dedicated full-context
  probe path, not this campaign. No consumer under src/kernels/xe; source tree-wide search found only
  generate setter and core/mtp consumer. This no-MTP campaign has no drafter or MTP prefill calls:
  retained flag is operationally no-op for selected campaign, not a claim of extra target synchronization.
- New Main actual CPU flag budget_stop_mock_quit_passed required; pure fixtures cover CPU budget,
  recursive once-only STOP/no partial-GEN STOP, reversed pair normalization, changed fingerprint and
  safety-env refusal, clean route labels, oversized-before-hash. Optional --owned-stop-output runs
  actual owned CPU mock STOP/cancel-DONE/normalQUIT with cancelled state false/incomplete. None ran here.

  preparation_receipt is exact path/SHA of Main-reviewed actual host-preparation/provenance proof.
  That proof requires passed/complete/main_reviewed=true, active/model_executed/gpu_executed=false,
  provenance_reviewed/whole_document_preserved=true, altered_to_fit=false, input equal to exact
  held_out_prompt.input pin, tokens equal to measured geometry, nonempty source_provenance object.
  Main must record actual corpus/document IDs/hashes, task boundaries, tokenizer/frontend/assets,
  rendering choices and original preparation receipts in that reviewed provenance. These booleans
  are Main attestations; parser cannot establish semantic independence or task completeness itself.
- Held-out source input<=2MiB checked BEFORE every hash/read. Body obtains all IDs unchanged,
  count must equal Main measurement and be in32768..65536, eachID0<=id<248320. Fresh normalized
  serialization writes all IDs; source/input SHA/provenance pins retained for both arms. No canonical
  task tail appended to heldout. Geometry/provenance checked before native model launch.

  actual_route=null/observed_prefill_chunks=null. Debug trace records actual observed chunks.
